text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One key area is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of written words. NLP also makes translation possible, so tools like Google Translate can change text from one language to another quickly. Another useful feature is sentiment analysis, which helps computers recognise whether a message is positive, negative, or neutral. This is helpful for companies checking customer opinions online. Finally, chatbots use NLP to communicate with people in a natural way, answering questions and solving simple problems. Thanks to NLP, our interaction with technology is becoming easier and more human every day.
